description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Earth 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Fire 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Lightning 2 with Stacking] based on if entry damage was Earth/Fire/Lightning damage, grants [Damage Cap +10000], [Zenith Mode], [Zenith Mode: Master (Earth, Fire, Lightning)]

description.name: Zenith Mode: Master (Earth, Fire, Lightning)
description.text: Increases [Fire/Lightning/Earth Infusion] damage bonus by 20%, cast speed x1.10 for PHY attacks, Monk abilities trigger 1 additional time, casts Spirit Attack: Master (Fire, Lightning, Earth) after using three Monk abilities (max 1), maximum HP +1500, grants [Astra] after taking the next action, removed if the character hasn't [Zenith Mode]

description.name: Fighting Frenzy+
description.text: Five single attacks (1.25 each) capped at 9999/19999 after 0-2/3+ uses, causes [DEF, RES and MND -15% (8s)] to the user

description.name: Spirit Attack: Master (Fire, Lightning, Earth)
description.text: Grants [Instant Cast 3], [Deadly Strikes +20% 3], and [Damage Cap +10000 3] to the user if 4+ Monk allies are alive, grants [Instant Cast 3] and [Deadly Strikes +20% 3] to the user if 0-3 Monk allies are alive

description.name: Attach Earth 2 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Earth Level by 2 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Earth 3

description.name: Attach Fire 2 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Fire Level by 2 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Fire 3

description.name: Attach Lightning 2 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Lightning Level by 2 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Lightning 3

description.name: Zenith Mode
description.text: Replaces certain Hero Abilities, certain Hero Abilities don't consume uses, after the duration the status only expires after the character takes an action
